brief.en: Click on bamboo, then a tile, to launch bamboo sticks
brief.zh: 点击后，选择一格发射竹竿

description.en: Bamboozles can fire 5 bamboo sticks at most.
description.zh: 整人竹可以发射最多 5 根竹竿。

chat.en: Only when confronting those skilled kongfu plants could you be defeated by a single straw.
chat.zh: 唯有在技艺高超的武林植物面前，你才会连一根草都打不过。

text.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
text.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

text.en: bamboo sticks turn into bamboo buskets when hitting the floor
text.zh: 竹竿在砸到地面时会变成竹篮
